x: He is stationed at Bicester, and owing to pressure of work finds little time for running. O.H.M.S. Jones rarely misses an opportunity of a training jaunt when on leave from Derby.

In a long letter he recalls his famous tussles with Tommy Green and Co., and hopes to be able to lend a hand on the official side after the war. "O.H.M.S." Jones, in spite of long hours, manages a five miles' run every week. His fellows think he's crackers—we don't!
